sloka: भरतस्य वधे दोषं नाहं पश्यामि राघव ।पूर्वापकारिणां त्यागे न ह्यधर्मो विधीयते ॥ २.९६.२४॥
transliteration: bharatasya vadhe doṣaṁ nāhaṁ paśyāmi rāghava ।pūrvāpakāriṇāṁ tyāge na hyadharmo vidhīyate ॥ 2.96.24॥

translations.english: O Rama, I do not see anything wrong in slaying Bharata. In killing one who had done harm is not an act of unrighteousness.
